title: 20-QUESTION CHALLENGE
outro_say: How many did you get out of twenty? Comment your score, and come back next Sunday for a new challenge!

questions.text:
What do honeybees
make?
questions.fact: They make it from flower nectar

questions.text: A tomato is a fruit
questions.say: True or false? A tomato is a fruit.
questions.fact: Botanically yes: it grows from a flower and holds seeds

questions.text:
How many days are
in a leap year?
questions.fact: February gets a 29th day

questions.text: Which one is a bird?
questions.fact: Bats are mammals; butterflies and bees are insects

questions.text:
A baby frog is
called a…
questions.fact: Tadpoles breathe with gills at first

questions.text:
Molten rock that reaches
the surface is called…
questions.fact: Underground, the same molten rock is called magma

questions.text: Peanuts are nuts
questions.say: True or false? Peanuts are nuts.
questions.fact: They're legumes, like peas and beans

questions.text:
Which planet is closest
to the Sun?
questions.fact: A year there lasts just 88 Earth days

questions.text: Which is colder?
questions.say: Which is colder: the North Pole, or the South Pole?
questions.fact: The South Pole sits on ice nearly 3 km thick

questions.text:
How many musicians play
in a string quartet?
questions.fact: Two violins, a viola and a cello

questions.text:
Hardest natural
substance?
questions.fact: Diamond is pure carbon, packed very tightly

questions.text:
Which one isn't
a prime number?
questions.say: Which one isn't a prime number?
questions.fact: 9 is 3 times 3

questions.text:
How many time zones does
China officially use?
questions.fact: The whole country runs on Beijing time

questions.text:
Lightning never strikes
the same place twice
questions.say: True or false? Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
questions.fact: Tall towers get hit many times a year

questions.text:
Which blood type is the
universal donor?
questions.say: Which blood type is the universal donor?
questions.fact: O negative red cells suit almost anyone

questions.text:
Easter Island belongs
to which country?
questions.fact: It's about 3,500 km off the Chilean coast

questions.text:
Which element has
the symbol Fe?
questions.say: Which element has the symbol F, E?
questions.fact: Fe comes from ferrum, Latin for iron

questions.text: Who has more bones?
questions.say: Who has more bones: a newborn baby, or an adult?
questions.fact: About 300 at birth; many fuse into 206

questions.text:
In which year did the
Berlin Wall fall?
questions.fact: Germany reunified the following year, 1990

questions.text: Which day is longer?
questions.say: Which is longer: a day on Earth, or a day on Mars?
questions.fact: A Martian day is about 40 minutes longer

yt.title: Weekly 20-Question Challenge: Easy to Expert 🏆 (Week 2)
yt.description:
This week's Sunday challenge: 20 new questions with a 10-second timer each, from honeybees and leap years up to blood types, Easter Island and the length of a day on Mars. Every answer comes with a quick fact. Keep count and comment your score out of 20 👇 A new challenge drops every Sunday.
